Chapter 735 - 735 What Kind Of Place Is This!

Chapter 735 - 735 What Kind of Place Is This!

735 What Kind of Place Is This!

The energy surged into Lin Fan’s body.

Lin Fan felt his body warm up. He took a step forward and disappeared.

….

At the center of the ocean universe.

Countless pieces of information flowed like water as they gathered.

The mermen gathered and analyzed in an orderly manner.

“Beep! Heavenly King Zach led his army to coordinates 5901, 234, 199.”

After this email appeared, the Fishmen’s figures could not help but pause slightly and look in the direction of the email.

“Keep an eye on Heavenly King Zach’s news,” said the merman in the upper position.”

“Yes, sir!”

As soon as he finished speaking, an urgent alarm suddenly sounded at the scene.

“Beep beep beep!”

“Z001,Z002,Z003.. Z009 signal lost.”

“Thump! Thump!”

The hearts of all the murlocs present suddenly beat faster.

All nine golden warships had lost their signals?

How was this possible?

The merman in the upper position suddenly stood up and said,”There must be an unknown magnetic field nearby. Now, call for King Zach at all frequencies.”

After all, there were nine golden warships!

There was even Heavenly King Zach.

If something happened to all of them, it would definitely be a huge earthquake in the universe! Tsunami!

“Yes, sir!” All the mermen responded in unison, and then quickly called Zach.

“Heavenly King Zach, please reply.”

“This is the center of the ocean universe, calling Heavenly King Zach.”

“Heavenly King Zach…”

The only response they got was a busy tone.

A moment later, the superior murloc fell back into his seat with a dejected expression.

He was terrified of the future of himself and the entire ocean universe.

After a while, he picked up the communicator and reported the specific situation.

….

Ocean universe palace.

“What?!” The nine-headed flood dragon looked at the report in front of it and shouted sternly.

“Boom!”

In the clear sky, thunder suddenly exploded. Countless lightning snakes instantly tore the sky apart.

“Spring Field 5901, 234, 199!”The nine-headed flood dragon shouted,” 5901 killed my Heavenly King Zach and annihilated my elites! He is the greatest enemy of our ocean universe! A year later, I will personally lead the army to destroy them and take revenge for Zach and the marine universe warriors! Raise the prestige of our ocean universe!”

“As ordered!”

Below, everyone kowtowed in unison, and their faces were still filled with horror.

Zach was dead, nine golden warships were destroyed, and the ocean universe master was fighting personally!

Every piece of news was shocking.

Now, they were all gathered together!

Something big… Rise!

….

As soon as the denunciation was issued, countless worlds began to discuss.

“Kill Zach and destroy nine golden warships! Oh my god, 5901, what is this place?”

“Zach, that’s a monarch level expert!”

“That must be where the Four Seasons Universe’s experts gather!”

“I told you, our Four Seasons Universe will definitely fight back!”

“That’s great!”

….

Four Seasons Universe Center, palace.

All the higher-ups gathered.

They had also heard the news about 5901 and were shocked.

“Isn’t our plan to temporarily give up on the Spring and Summer Regions and focus our forces on protecting the Autumn and Winter Regions? Who was the power of 5901?”

“This power was actually able to kill Zach and destroy 10 golden warships. It’s terrifyingly powerful!”

“Is this the hidden power of our Four Seasons Universe?”

“Maybe it’s a backup plan for us universe masters?”

Everyone spoke one after another, causing the originally dull palace to gradually become lively.

Everyone’s faces were filled with anticipation.

His expectations for the future.

“Ta Ta!”

At this moment, the First Elder slowly walked over.

Everyone suddenly stopped talking and looked at the First Elder with questioning eyes.

” I know what you’re thinking,” the great elder sighed.” Unfortunately, 5901 isn’t a backup plan for universe masters. Our policy has always been to temporarily retreat to the Autumn and Winter regions. We didn’t hide this power…”

“I don’t even know what this power is!”

“This is an unfamiliar and powerful faction. The only thing worth rejoicing about is that it seems to be helping our Four Seasons Universe.”

When everyone heard this, they all revealed a bitter expression.

The Great Elder turned to look at the Spring Territory Master and said,””Do you know 5901?”

“I don’t know.” The Lord of Spring shook his head.”

At this moment, Mu Jun Qin Xian opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but no words came out.

The Lord of Spring noticed this and asked,”Mu Jun, what’s the matter?”

Mu Jun was one of his most trusted subordinates.

Many things in the Spring Field were handled by him, and he could be considered the chief butler of the Spring Field.

“Zone Leader, do you still remember the time when you asked me to recruit talents from all over the world to participate in the cosmic contest?”

The Lord of Spring could not help but frown.

In the past, the struggle for hegemony in the universe was indeed a very important matter.

However, couldn’t he tell what was going on?

The Spring Field was about to be completely conquered, and the entire Four Seasons Universe might be completely destroyed!

Qin Xian also saw the change in the Lord of Spring’s expression. He could not help but complain in his heart.

However, if he didn’t finish his sentence halfway, it would be even worse.

Therefore, Qin Xian could only brace himself and continue,””Before the universe contest, I went to 5901.”

“Buzz!”

Instantly, everyone in the palace gathered their gazes.

Although Qin Xian and the Lord of Spring were chatting softly.

However, how profound were the cultivation levels of the people present?

He easily heard their conversation.

Qin Xian felt as if he was being crushed by a huge mountain under everyone’s gaze. He felt extremely heavy, and sweat rolled down his forehead.

“You’re the Wood Lord of the Spring Field, right?”

“You just said that you went to 5901?”

Seeing that Qin Xian was still in a daze, the Spring Territory Master couldn’t help but shout in a low voice,””Mu Jun, why aren’t you answering the Great Elder’s question?”

Only then did Qin Xian react and hurriedly said,”First Elder, I did go to 5901, probably a few decades ago.”

When the Great Elder heard this, a golden light flashed in his eyes that were hidden behind the mask. He said,”Oh? What kind of planet was 5901?”

“I didn’t enter the planet…” Qin Xian said.

Everyone frowned when they heard that.

” I only came to the outside of planet 5901 because there was a powerful array on the surface of the planet that blocked me. However, just from the outside, I saw countless spirit dragons on this planet!” Qin Xian said hurriedly.”

Everyone’s expression changed slightly.

Spirit Dragon!

This was a special image that would only be produced when the spiritual energy was extremely dense.

Planet 5901 was indeed extraordinary!

“Also, I met the leader of planet 5901.”

“Buzz!”

When everyone heard this, they all used even more focused gazes to gather on Qin Xian.
